note: Web copies of Matt's models (tools/assets/build-models.mjs). Each entry: source, the glb in the source folder (Ebb/_assets, never committed); out, the web copy's name under assets/models/camp/; sizeM, its real size along `along` (longest: its longest side; height: y); yawDeg, a turn about +y so its front faces +z; triangles, the target after thinning (never more than it has); maps, the paint maps' size in pixels; paint (an OBJ source with no paint, such as the single log): the model whose map gives its colours, laid on as vertex colours (obj-source.mjs; style stone: the source's greys in blotches with pale flecks); subdivide: each triangle into four that many times first, so a light model has vertices enough for its paint; restFlat: laid on its flattest side. A new model is one more entry, then a re-run. Real sizes agreed with Matt on October 22, 2026, against the 1.4 m walker.
